$description: Confetti design tokens, W3C DTCG format. One group per theme+mode; values are fully resolved (accessibility exceptions applied).

100.$description: lightest cream — raised surfaces

a16.$description: cream at 16% — the dark-mode counterpart to ink.a12

600.$description: canonical Ink — warm near-black, text and borders

a86.$description: ink 900 at 86% — the modal / lightbox scrim (deeper base than the a12/a18/a24 borders)

400.$description: card — the lightest dark surface, so it sets the contrast floor for everything that sits on dark. Held here because it is the lightest value at which red.200, chalk.400 and green.400 all still clear AA; a step lighter and the brand red has no usable value left.

800.$description: page background baseline — the content ground. Not black: black sits below it as `backdrop`, which is what gives that role its meaning back.

900.$description: backdrop — the recessed mat below page, and now genuinely below it. True black.

a16.$description: chalk at 16% — subtle border on graphite

100.$description: primary text and borders on graphite

400.$description: muted text on graphite — clears AA on `card`, the lightest of them (5.16:1). Tied to how light `card` is: it had to go this pale once the surfaces came up.

200.$description: confetti brand Red, lifted furthest — the palest step, and the ONLY one that reads AS TEXT on every dark surface including `card` (4.96:1). This is also the ceiling that fixes how light `card` can go: there is nothing paler to fall back on.

300.$description: confetti brand Red, lifted — reads on the darker surfaces but not on card (3.50:1). Only usable as the dark accent when `card` is close to black, which it no longer is.

600.$description: deepened Red — the hazard stripe on a danger control. 1.26:1 against the 500 fill: barely a shade, which is all it needs now the bands are 8px and moving. Motion and width carry the pattern; darkness would only make it shout.

100.$description: pale tint — the subtle end of the pair in LIGHT mode, carrying green.700 (5.25:1)

400.$description: success AS TEXT on a dark surface — lifted enough to clear AA on card, the lightest dark surface (5.5:1)

600.$description: the rich green — success as a FILL, carrying a white label (5.34:1). Same in both modes; a fill does not need to move.

700.$description: success AS TEXT on a light surface (4.86:1 on cream)

800.$description: deep tint — the subtle end of the pair in DARK mode, carrying chalk (10.37:1)

300.$description: brand, lifted enough to read AS TEXT on the forest dark surface

500.$description: Adventure brand green — reads as text on sand (4.8:1) and as button fill w/ white (6.6:1)

100.$description: raised

a12.$description: bark at 12% — subtle border on sand

600.$description: warm near-black — Adventure light-mode text and borders

800.$description: Adventure dark page

a16.$description: sand at 16% — subtle border on forest

600.$description: deep magenta — brand AS TEXT on light

100.$description: raised

900.$description: neon light text / border — deep purple

600.$description: card

800.$description: raised

100.$description: neon dark text / border — light lavender

on-scrim.$description: text and controls placed directly on the scrim rather than on a panel — a lightbox caption, a close button. It cannot be text.primary (which follows the mode and would vanish in light) or text.inverse (which follows it the other way and vanishes in dark): the scrim is deep in BOTH modes, so its foreground is fixed like it is.

backdrop.$description: recessed mat — collapses to the deepest forest (no darker neutral; demo default)

subtle.$description: the tint end goes deep in dark, like the accent tints

text.$description: danger AS TEXT — the palest red, and the same lift brand-as-text takes. It has to be the palest one: red.300 fails on Confetti's `card` (3.50:1) and on Adventure's #35492f and Neon's #2e1650 too, so no theme on this mode can afford the more saturated step.

deep.$description: the hazard stripe on a danger control

thin.$description: 1px — soft pill / chip outline (Badge, Tabs indicator)

hard-ink.$description: hard offset shadow — the sticker lift, no blur

hard-cream.$description: dark-mode counterpart — light offset against dark surfaces

flat.$description: no shadow — pressed, and the resting default

button-lift.$description: buttons do NOT lift — they brighten on hover instead

brightness-rest.$description: 1 — no lightness change, the pressed counterpart to a theme's hover brightness

button-hover-brightness.$description: hover lightness multiplier for buttons that change lightness instead of lifting

subtle.$description: outer bound of the hand-placed sticker tilt — components scale this by a per-instance multiplier in -1..1

max.$description: outer bound of the hand-placed sticker angle

drift.$description: one loop of a continuous ambient motion — slow enough to read as texture moving, not as a control reacting

ambient.$description: one loop of a continuous, non-reactive animation — a texture that drifts rather than a state that changes

linear.$description: the only correct curve for a seamless loop — any easing makes a continuous animation pulse at the seam

ambient.$description: constant speed, so a looping animation has no perceptible seam

lift.$description: how far an interactive surface rises on hover

button-lift.$description: the hover transform on filled buttons — a lift, or rest (no move), per theme

dialog-md.$description: the default dialog — a paragraph or two plus actions

18.$description: utility step — off the 4px grid (like 14), for body-large / small subheads

22.$description: utility step — off the 4px grid, sits between h5 (20) and h4 (24)

hero.$description: container-query driven headline, above the fixed ramp

display.$description: hero only — fluid, sits above h1

h6.$description: meets body size — weight and family carry the distinction

thumb.$description: 20px — leaves a 2px inset on each side of the track

sm.$description: 16px — inline with body and control labels

primary.$description: pine green — reads as text on sand (4.7:1) and as button fill with white (6.5:1)

border-width.$description: soft pill — 1px hairline, not the 2px sticker edge

border-color.$description: soft pill — subtle tint, not the ink sticker border

neutral.$description: paper fill — a badge that isn't a category

stripe-width.$description: 8px band, so the diagonal repeats every 16px

stripe-duration.$description: one full pass of the pattern

muted.$description: comments and punctuation — present but receding

padding-x.$description: 4px — snug, so the chip does not disturb the line

padding-y.$description: 0 — vertical padding on an inline box shifts line height without growing the line

font-family.$description: the mono face — same one Badge and Tabs label with

shadow.$description: the sticker lift, held at rest — a dialog is already raised

gap.$description: 16px between header, body, and footer

scrim-bg.$description: the dim itself — the one consumer of the axis-independent --color-scrim role, fixed across themes and modes

fg.$description: set on the scrim so anything placed straight onto it inherits a legible colour. Content that brings its own surface (Modal's panel) overrides this with its own foreground.

viewport-padding.$description: 24px — keeps the content off the viewport edge on small screens

height.$description: 48px — the hit area, not the rail

fill-bg.$description: the travelled portion — brand, so progress reads at a glance

thumb-shadow.$description: the sticker lift, held at rest — the knob sits above the rail

gap.$description: 8px between the rail and an adjacent label or value

border-width.$description: the sticker edge — a switch is a control, so it carries the same outline as a button

thumb-bg.$description: ink knob on the paper track

thumb-bg-checked.$description: and the inverse on the brand track

icon-color.$description: the glyph sits ON the thumb, so it takes the track's fill

gap.$description: 8px between the switch and an adjacent label

track-radius.$description: matches the pill — the rail is a control, not a container, so it takes the same radius the indicator does (999px round in Confetti, 12px in Adventure, square in Neon)

gap.$description: 4px between tabs

hover-fg.$description: an idle tab warms to full-strength text on hover, short of the lit pill

font-size.$description: 14px mono — the control label, sized for legibility

tab-padding-x.$description: 20px — roomy, so the control reads at a comfortable tap size

border-width.$description: the 2px sticker edge — same as Card

shadow.$description: the hard offset — a toast sits above the page, and this is how this system says so

min-width.$description: matches the small dialog, so a toast and a confirmation read as the same family

ambient.$description: constant speed, so a looping animation has no perceptible seam

lift.$description: how far an interactive surface rises on hover

button-lift.$description: the hover transform on filled buttons — a lift, or rest (no move), per theme

dialog-md.$description: the default dialog — a paragraph or two plus actions

18.$description: utility step — off the 4px grid (like 14), for body-large / small subheads

22.$description: utility step — off the 4px grid, sits between h5 (20) and h4 (24)

hero.$description: container-query driven headline, above the fixed ramp

display.$description: hero only — fluid, sits above h1

h6.$description: meets body size — weight and family carry the distinction

thumb.$description: 20px — leaves a 2px inset on each side of the track

sm.$description: 16px — inline with body and control labels

primary.$description: brand color — drives text.accent, primary action fill, ghost hover

surface.$description: deepest ink — the code block ground

border-width.$description: soft pill — 1px hairline, not the 2px sticker edge

border-color.$description: soft pill — subtle tint, not the ink sticker border

neutral.$description: paper fill — a badge that isn't a category

stripe-width.$description: 8px band, so the diagonal repeats every 16px

stripe-duration.$description: one full pass of the pattern

muted.$description: comments and punctuation — present but receding

padding-x.$description: 4px — snug, so the chip does not disturb the line

padding-y.$description: 0 — vertical padding on an inline box shifts line height without growing the line

font-family.$description: the mono face — same one Badge and Tabs label with

shadow.$description: the sticker lift, held at rest — a dialog is already raised

gap.$description: 16px between header, body, and footer

scrim-bg.$description: the dim itself — the one consumer of the axis-independent --color-scrim role, fixed across themes and modes

fg.$description: set on the scrim so anything placed straight onto it inherits a legible colour. Content that brings its own surface (Modal's panel) overrides this with its own foreground.

viewport-padding.$description: 24px — keeps the content off the viewport edge on small screens

height.$description: 48px — the hit area, not the rail

fill-bg.$description: the travelled portion — brand, so progress reads at a glance

thumb-shadow.$description: the sticker lift, held at rest — the knob sits above the rail

gap.$description: 8px between the rail and an adjacent label or value

border-width.$description: the sticker edge — a switch is a control, so it carries the same outline as a button

thumb-bg.$description: ink knob on the paper track

thumb-bg-checked.$description: and the inverse on the brand track

icon-color.$description: the glyph sits ON the thumb, so it takes the track's fill

gap.$description: 8px between the switch and an adjacent label

track-radius.$description: matches the pill — the rail is a control, not a container, so it takes the same radius the indicator does (999px round in Confetti, 12px in Adventure, square in Neon)

gap.$description: 4px between tabs

hover-fg.$description: an idle tab warms to full-strength text on hover, short of the lit pill

font-size.$description: 14px mono — the control label, sized for legibility

tab-padding-x.$description: 20px — roomy, so the control reads at a comfortable tap size

border-width.$description: the 2px sticker edge — same as Card

shadow.$description: the hard offset — a toast sits above the page, and this is how this system says so

min-width.$description: matches the small dialog, so a toast and a confirmation read as the same family

100.$description: lightest cream — raised surfaces

a16.$description: cream at 16% — the dark-mode counterpart to ink.a12

600.$description: canonical Ink — warm near-black, text and borders

a86.$description: ink 900 at 86% — the modal / lightbox scrim (deeper base than the a12/a18/a24 borders)

400.$description: card — the lightest dark surface, so it sets the contrast floor for everything that sits on dark. Held here because it is the lightest value at which red.200, chalk.400 and green.400 all still clear AA; a step lighter and the brand red has no usable value left.

800.$description: page background baseline — the content ground. Not black: black sits below it as `backdrop`, which is what gives that role its meaning back.

900.$description: backdrop — the recessed mat below page, and now genuinely below it. True black.

a16.$description: chalk at 16% — subtle border on graphite

100.$description: primary text and borders on graphite

400.$description: muted text on graphite — clears AA on `card`, the lightest of them (5.16:1). Tied to how light `card` is: it had to go this pale once the surfaces came up.

200.$description: confetti brand Red, lifted furthest — the palest step, and the ONLY one that reads AS TEXT on every dark surface including `card` (4.96:1). This is also the ceiling that fixes how light `card` can go: there is nothing paler to fall back on.

300.$description: confetti brand Red, lifted — reads on the darker surfaces but not on card (3.50:1). Only usable as the dark accent when `card` is close to black, which it no longer is.

600.$description: deepened Red — the hazard stripe on a danger control. 1.26:1 against the 500 fill: barely a shade, which is all it needs now the bands are 8px and moving. Motion and width carry the pattern; darkness would only make it shout.

100.$description: pale tint — the subtle end of the pair in LIGHT mode, carrying green.700 (5.25:1)

400.$description: success AS TEXT on a dark surface — lifted enough to clear AA on card, the lightest dark surface (5.5:1)

600.$description: the rich green — success as a FILL, carrying a white label (5.34:1). Same in both modes; a fill does not need to move.

700.$description: success AS TEXT on a light surface (4.86:1 on cream)

800.$description: deep tint — the subtle end of the pair in DARK mode, carrying chalk (10.37:1)

300.$description: brand, lifted enough to read AS TEXT on the forest dark surface

500.$description: Adventure brand green — reads as text on sand (4.8:1) and as button fill w/ white (6.6:1)

100.$description: raised

a12.$description: bark at 12% — subtle border on sand

600.$description: warm near-black — Adventure light-mode text and borders

800.$description: Adventure dark page

a16.$description: sand at 16% — subtle border on forest

600.$description: deep magenta — brand AS TEXT on light

100.$description: raised

900.$description: neon light text / border — deep purple

600.$description: card

800.$description: raised

100.$description: neon dark text / border — light lavender

on-scrim.$description: text and controls placed directly on the scrim rather than on a panel — a lightbox caption, a close button. It cannot be text.primary (which follows the mode and would vanish in light) or text.inverse (which follows it the other way and vanishes in dark): the scrim is deep in BOTH modes, so its foreground is fixed like it is.

backdrop.$description: recessed mat — collapses to the deepest synth (no darker neutral; demo default)

subtle.$description: the tint end goes deep in dark, like the accent tints

text.$description: danger AS TEXT — the palest red, and the same lift brand-as-text takes. It has to be the palest one: red.300 fails on Confetti's `card` (3.50:1) and on Adventure's #35492f and Neon's #2e1650 too, so no theme on this mode can afford the more saturated step.

deep.$description: the hazard stripe on a danger control

thin.$description: 1px — soft pill / chip outline (Badge, Tabs indicator)

flat.$description: no shadow — pressed, and the resting default
